findings.scope: Five payloads are byte-correct under independent raw DEFLATE extraction but have wrong Adler-32 trailers; recovered and BCL decoders reject them. Empty inputs produce no zlib frame. This is separate from active on-screen renderer acceptance.

diagnosis: Original IL uses signed int32 accumulators and signed remainder; recovered arithmetic matches. NMAX5552 permits sums above signed32 capacity. The observed failure supports an original signed-overflow checksum defect, not a demonstrated decompiler-only bug.
